templates.source: Y11 Foundation Autumn B6 Work with circles · S1 Area and circumference of a circle
templates.text: A circle has a radius of [[r]] cm. Work out its circumference and area to 1 decimal place.
templates.answer: Circumference [[2 * r * 3.14159265|dp:1]] cm; area [[r * r * 3.14159265|dp:1]] cm²

templates.subtopic: Area and circumference of a circle
templates.source: Y11 Foundation Autumn B6 Work with circles · S1 Area and circumference of a circle
templates.text: A circle has radius [[r]] cm. Mia says its circumference and its area are the same number. Is she right? Work out both in terms of $\pi$.
templates.answer: Circumference $[[2 * r]]\pi$, area $[[r * r]]\pi$: [[r == 2|if:she is right only because the radius is 2/she is not right: the numbers are different]]
